title: Link to Your Own Pages
prompt:
Relative links connect pages of the same site. The page lives next to `about.html` and `projects.html`. Add a paragraph with a relative link to `about.html` reading `About this site`, and a second link to `projects.html` reading `See my projects`.

Rules:
- Both links use relative URLs (no `https://`, no leading `/`).
- Link text exactly as given.
boilerplate: Welcome

tests.name: relative link to about.html
tests.hint: Relative URLs name the file directly: href="about.html". No https:// and no leading slash.

tests.name: relative link to projects.html
tests.hint: Same pattern: href="projects.html" with the text 'See my projects'.

tests.name: no absolute URLs anywhere
tests.hint: This challenge wants relative links only — point at the local files.
